export default "---\ntitle: Segments\ndescription: Build contact segments to target groups for drip campaign enrollment.\n---\n\nSegments are saved contact filters. They let you define a group of contacts by shared attributes — tags, status, company, industry, or LinkedIn presence — and then bulk-enroll that group into a drip campaign with a single click.\n\n## Navigating to Segments\n\nClick **Segments** in the left sidebar.\n\n## Creating a Segment\n\nClick **Create**. Give the segment a name and optional description, then use the **Filter Builder** to define which contacts belong to it.\n\n### Filter Builder\n\nFilters combine with AND logic — a contact must match every criterion you set.\n\n| Filter | How it works |\n|---|---|\n| **Status** | Match contacts by their CRM status (e.g. In contract, Prospect, Lost) |\n| **Tags** | Match contacts that have any of the selected tags |\n| **Companies** | Match contacts at one or more specific companies (searchable multi-select) |\n| **Industry sectors** | Match contacts whose company is in a selected sector |\n| **Has LinkedIn** | Match only contacts with a LinkedIn URL on file |\n\nYou can combine multiple filters. For example: Status = Prospect + Tags includes \"warm-lead\" + Industry = SaaS.\n\n### Live Contact Count\n\nBelow the filter builder, a live count shows how many contacts currently match your filters. This updates as you adjust the criteria — useful for sanity-checking before enrolling.\n\n## Viewing a Segment\n\nClick any segment in the list to open its detail page. The detail page shows:\n\n- A **Filter Summary** resolving company names, sector labels, and tag names in plain language\n- The **live contact count** for the current filter criteria\n- An **Enroll** button to enroll matching contacts into a campaign\n\n## Enrolling a Segment\n\nOn the segment detail page, click **Enroll**. A dialog appears to select the target campaign. Only **Active** campaigns are available for enrollment.\n\nClick **Enroll** to confirm. The system enrolls every contact currently matching the segment's filters, skipping any contact already enrolled in that campaign. This makes re-running an enrollment safe — it will only pick up new contacts.\n\n:::note\nEnrollment is a snapshot at the time you click Enroll. Contacts added later who match the filters are not automatically enrolled — re-run the enrollment to pick them up.\n:::\n\n## Editing a Segment\n\nClick **Edit** on the segment detail page to adjust the filters or rename the segment. Changes to filters do not retroactively affect existing enrollments — they only affect future enrollment runs.\n\n## Segment Strategy Tips\n\n- **Use tags for intent signals** — tag contacts as \"warm-lead\", \"event-attendee\", or \"inbound\" to create precise, manageable segments.\n- **Sector targeting** — use the industry filter to send sector-specific messaging without creating separate contact lists.\n- **Combine company + status** — narrow to contacts at target accounts who are not yet in contract.\n- **Check count before enrolling** — the live count preview prevents accidentally enrolling thousands of contacts into the wrong campaign.\n"
