export default "---\ntitle: Drip Campaigns\ndescription: Create and manage multi-step email drip campaigns in epiSolve CRM.\n---\n\nDrip campaigns let you send a sequence of automated emails to contacts over time. Each campaign is made up of steps — individual emails sent at configurable intervals. Contacts are enrolled via segments, and the system tracks every delivery, open, click, bounce, and unsubscribe.\n\n## Navigating to Campaigns\n\nClick **Campaigns** in the left sidebar. The campaign list shows all campaigns with their status badge (Draft, Active, Paused, Archived).\n\n## Creating a Campaign\n\nClick **Create** in the top right.\n\n- **Name** — the internal label for this campaign\n- **Slug** — a URL-safe identifier (auto-derived from the name, editable)\n- **Description** — optional context for your team\n- **Status** — start with **Draft** while building steps; switch to **Active** when ready to send\n\nSave to open the campaign detail page.\n\n## Managing Steps\n\nEach step is one email in the sequence. Open the **Steps** tab on the campaign detail page.\n\n### Editing a Step\n\nClick any step row to expand it, then click the **pencil icon** to enter edit mode.\n\n- **Subject** — the email subject line. Use `{first_name}` to personalise.\n- **Delay (days)** — how many days after the previous step this email sends. Set to `0` for the first step to send on the day of enrollment.\n- **Body** — a rich-text editor (bold, italic, links, lists). Use `{first_name}` anywhere in the body too.\n\nClick **Save** to commit changes, or **Cancel** to discard.\n\n### Adding a Step\n\nClick **Add step** below the step list. A new step is appended with a 7-day delay and blank subject/body. Edit it immediately.\n\n:::tip[Step count guidance]\nClick the **ⓘ** icon next to Add step to see best-practice guidance on campaign length and spacing. The sweet spot for B2B outreach is **4–6 steps**. A warning appears at 6+ steps; adding is disabled at 8.\n:::\n\n### Deleting a Step\n\nOnly the **last step** can be deleted (to avoid gaps in active enrollments). A trash icon appears on the final step when there is more than one step. Click it and confirm the inline prompt.\n\n### Sending a Test Email\n\nWhile editing a step — or with a step expanded in read-only view — a **Send test email** panel appears at the bottom. Enter (or edit) a recipient address and click **Send test**. The address is remembered for future test sends. The test email arrives with a `[TEST]` prefix in the subject and a yellow banner so it's clearly identifiable.\n\n## Analytics\n\nThe campaign detail page shows a header with six live metrics:\n\n| Tile | What it measures |\n|---|---|\n| Enrolled | Total contacts enrolled in this campaign |\n| Delivered | Emails confirmed delivered by Resend |\n| Open rate | Unique opens ÷ delivered |\n| Click rate | Unique clicks ÷ delivered |\n| Completed | Contacts who finished all steps |\n| Suppressed | Contacts removed due to bounce, complaint, or unsubscribe |\n\nThese update in real time as email events arrive from Resend.\n\n## Enrollments Tab\n\nThe **Enrollments** tab lists every enrolled contact with their current status:\n\n- **Active (step N)** — in the campaign, waiting for step N to send\n- **Completed** — finished all steps\n- **Suppressed** — removed (with reason shown on hover)\n\nEach row also shows a mini delivery summary: number of emails sent (✉), opened (👁), and clicked (🖱) for that contact.\n\n## Cloning a Campaign\n\nTo duplicate an existing campaign (e.g. to reuse copy for a different audience), click **Clone** in the campaign header. A dialog pre-fills the name as \"Copy of [original name]\" with a derived slug. Edit either field, then click **Clone**. The new campaign is created as Draft with all steps copied, and you are redirected to it immediately.\n\n## Campaign Statuses\n\n| Status | Meaning |\n|---|---|\n| Draft | Being built — drip sender skips this campaign |\n| Active | Live — drip sender processes enrollments daily |\n| Paused | Temporarily stopped — no new sends until Active again |\n| Archived | Retired — kept for reference, not processed |\n\nChange status via the **Edit** button on the campaign detail page.\n"
